trust_decision.summary: micromatch.braces decides whether a caller-supplied pattern contains a brace pair using the backtracking regex /\{.*\}/ on the untrusted pattern string, which is super-linear on long inputs with many '{' and no closing '}'.

landing_point.why: Only regex in the brace pre-check; the advisory names micromatch.braces and the /\{.*\}/ test is the single place it is used.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API micromatch.braceExpand(pattern, options) (unchanged; reaches the site via micromatch.braces)
fix_sites.module_kind: thin wrapper in the same file

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No other route exists to dismiss: the vulnerable regex is used once (index.js:448) and the only other regex in the package, /\\/g at index.js:72, is linear.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Patterns with no '{...}' pair (including '}{', '{foo', 'foo}') must be returned unchanged as [pattern] and nobrace:true must still short-circuit; a naive includes('{')&&includes('}') fix or always calling braces() changes that output.

O6_input_shapes: single string pattern (non-strings rejected with TypeError at index.js:447)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A brace pre-check in micromatch.parse before braces(String(pattern)) using the same /\{.*\}/ idiom (parse currently calls braces() unconditionally).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer could plausibly copy the braces() short-circuit into parse as a micro-optimisation, the way index.js:448 does; it would still be a where-type sibling in the same file.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333), polynomial backtracking in a pre-check regex

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap /\{.*\}/ for a linear indexOf('{') / indexOf('}', i) scan, which is in fact the published fix and is found immediately.

out_of_scope_notes: Glob-to-regex compilation and brace expansion live in the picomatch and braces dependencies (outside this repository); any ReDoS there is out of scope.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; judged tiny from the tree (one source file, index.js, plus tests).
Latest release not provided, so present_in_latest was not checked.
j_multi_site=1 only because braceExpand reaches the same site through braces (O1=2); there is still one check at one location.
